html:
/* {{BuffLink}}: icon + name, the buff card opens beside it on hover (tip=left: on the left side) */
.aa-bufftip {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
  vertical-align: middle;
}
.aa-bufftip-ico {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-block;
  width: 22px;    /* the default size; size= on the template sets it per icon */
  height: 22px;
  line-height: 0;
  box-shadow: 0 0 3px rgba(78, 194, 78, 0.6);   /* the green glow of a buff, like the skill cards */
}
.aa-bufftip-ico.aa-bufftip-bad {
  box-shadow: 0 0 3px rgba(217, 66, 58, 0.7);   /* a debuff: red */
}
/* the frame (black edge, green line) is drawn over the edge of the icon, like the grade border of {{Item}} */
.aa-bufftip-ico::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #000, inset 0 0 0 2px #4ec24e;
}
.aa-bufftip-name {
  color: #4ec24e;   /* the colour of a buff (the green of its frame): change here */
  font-weight: bold;
}
.aa-bufftip-name.aa-bufftip-debuff {
  color: #FF7B6B;   /* the colour of a debuff */
}
.aa-bufftip-bad::after {
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #000, inset 0 0 0 2px #d9423a;
}
.aa-bufftip-card {
  display: none;
  position: absolute;
  top: -8px;
  left: 100%;
  z-index: 200;
  padding-left: 6px;   /* no gap, so the card stays open while the pointer moves onto it */
  white-space: normal;
  font-weight: normal;
  font-style: normal;
  text-align: left;
  cursor: default;
}
.aa-bufftip-left .aa-bufftip-card {
  left: auto;
  right: 100%;
  padding-left: 0;
  padding-right: 6px;
}
.aa-bufftip:hover .aa-bufftip-card {
  display: block;
}
/* Phones: no room beside the buff, the card opens below it */
@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .aa-bufftip-card,
  .aa-bufftip-left .aa-bufftip-card {
    top: 100%;
    left: 0;
    right: auto;
    padding: 4px 0 0;
  }
}

/* the card (the look of the buff box in the game: no frame on the icon, the kind above the name, the line of the skill cards) */
.aa-buff {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  width: 300px;
  max-width: 100%;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(24, 28, 38, 0.97), rgba(10, 12, 18, 0.97));
  border: 1px solid #5a5040;
  border-radius: 3px;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #000, 0 4px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
  color: #e8e4d8;
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  text-align: left;
}
.aa-buff-head {
  display: flex;
  gap: 10px;
  align-items: flex-start;
}
.aa-buff-icon {
  line-height: 0;
  flex: none;
}
.aa-buff-title {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  line-height: 1.25;
}
.aa-buff-kind {
  color: #e8e4d8;
  font-size: 13px;
}
.aa-buff-name {
  font-size: 17px;
  font-weight: normal;
}
.aa-buff-sep {
  height: 1px;
  margin: 8px 0;
  background: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, #6a5d48, transparent);   /* the line of the skill cards */
}
.aa-buff-text {
  color: #e8e4d8;
}
.aa-buff-text .aa-item-gap {
  margin-top: 0.7em;
}
.aa-buff-time {
  margin-top: 8px;
  color: #e6d3a3;
}

/* ===== THEME COLOURS (dark + light) ===== */
/* Colours for the wiki's two themes. Light: wiki set to Day, or Auto with a light browser. Dark: Night, or Auto with a dark browser. */
/* LIGHT */
html.skin-theme-clientpref-day .aa-buff { background: linear-gradient(to bottom, #fffaf0, #f5ecdb); border-color: #c9b998; border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(80, 55, 25, .22); color: #3a2f26; }
html.skin-theme-clientpref-day .aa-buff-kind,
html.skin-theme-clientpref-day .aa-buff-text { color: #3a2f26; }
html.skin-theme-clientpref-day .aa-buff-time { color: #8a5f00; }
html.skin-theme-clientpref-day .aa-bufftip-name.aa-bufftip-debuff { color: #b3261e; }
html.skin-theme-clientpref-day .aa-bufftip-name { color: #3f7a12; }
html.skin-theme-clientpref-day .aa-buff-sep { background: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, #c4b391, transparent); }
html.skin-theme-clientpref-day .aa-buff span[style*="color"] { filter: brightness(.62) saturate(1.25); }
@media (prefers-color-scheme: light) {
html.skin-theme-clientpref-os .aa-buff { background: linear-gradient(to bottom, #fffaf0, #f5ecdb); border-color: #c9b998; border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(80, 55, 25, .22); color: #3a2f26; }
html.skin-theme-clientpref-os .aa-buff-kind,
html.skin-theme-clientpref-os .aa-buff-text { color: #3a2f26; }
html.skin-theme-clientpref-os .aa-buff-time { color: #8a5f00; }
html.skin-theme-clientpref-os .aa-bufftip-name.aa-bufftip-debuff { color: #b3261e; }
html.skin-theme-clientpref-os .aa-bufftip-name { color: #3f7a12; }
html.skin-theme-clientpref-os .aa-buff-sep { background: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, #c4b391, transparent); }
html.skin-theme-clientpref-os .aa-buff span[style*="color"] { filter: brightness(.62) saturate(1.25); }
}
/* DARK */
html.skin-theme-clientpref-night .aa-buff { background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(46, 38, 32, .98), rgba(27, 21, 17, .98)); border-color: #6a5340; border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, .55), 0 6px 18px rgba(0, 0, 0, .6); color: #e8e1d6; }
html.skin-theme-clientpref-night .aa-buff-kind,
html.skin-theme-clientpref-night .aa-buff-text { color: #e8e1d6; }
html.skin-theme-clientpref-night .aa-buff-time { color: #f5cb65; }
html.skin-theme-clientpref-night .aa-bufftip-name.aa-bufftip-debuff { color: #f0563c; }
html.skin-theme-clientpref-night .aa-bufftip-name { color: #9acd32; }
html.skin-theme-clientpref-night .aa-buff-sep { background: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, #6a5340, transparent); }
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
html.skin-theme-clientpref-os .aa-buff { background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(46, 38, 32, .98), rgba(27, 21, 17, .98)); border-color: #6a5340; border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, .55), 0 6px 18px rgba(0, 0, 0, .6); color: #e8e1d6; }
html.skin-theme-clientpref-os .aa-buff-kind,
html.skin-theme-clientpref-os .aa-buff-text { color: #e8e1d6; }
html.skin-theme-clientpref-os .aa-buff-time { color: #f5cb65; }
html.skin-theme-clientpref-os .aa-bufftip-name.aa-bufftip-debuff { color: #f0563c; }
html.skin-theme-clientpref-os .aa-bufftip-name { color: #9acd32; }
html.skin-theme-clientpref-os .aa-buff-sep { background: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, #6a5340, transparent); }
}
